title: Read science capacity separately from delivered output
description: Four ordinary players start a real campaign. The owner opens the private science source ledger, queues Innovation and recovers the earned new capacity separately from delivered science. Demo catalogue/admission/research clock and leased tick delivery are explicitly labelled harness controls; no stored state is injected.

steps.description: Read the scheduled next tick beside the campaign, with roster and campaign navigation retained. Phone uses one resource entry to the existing ledgers.
steps.acknowledgement: The real active campaign exposes its resource opener and next scheduled tick.
verifications: The rail and each named navigation control fit without automatic scrolling; the phone rail leaves more room for the chart.

steps.description: Open the real per-tick rail control on both independent accounts. Current capacity exists before the first delivered output.
steps.acknowledgement: Both authorized ledgers acknowledge tick0, current1.4 capacity and their own completed station.
verifications: The two ordinary views name different owned orbital sources, and no historical output is substituted for capacity.

steps.description: Return to the same galaxy and queue Innovation through ordinary research controls. Capacity remains1.4 until the level is earned.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual research receipt accepts Innovation for tick1.
verifications: The peer remains at its own initial rate and source while the owner order is accepted.

steps.description: Existing guarded demo clock and fifteen real leased ticks, concurrent/repeated delivery. No levels, resources or private projections injected; not hosted Scheduler certification.

steps.description: Reload both accounts and inspect the earned new rate separately from tick15 output. The peer retains its independent sources and rate.
steps.acknowledgement: Authoritative tick15 supplies owner1.404 capacity while last delivered science is1.4; peer remains1.4.
verifications: Source identity and peer ownership remain isolated through reload; lower totals stay inside the reading viewport.

steps.description: Reload the existing acknowledged campaign with normal motion, open its actual science rail using Enter, then Tab into the bounded ledger. No campaign command is sent.
steps.acknowledgement: The mounted private ledger recovers the confirmed tick, current capacity and delivered output under the selected motion preference.
verifications: Authorized rates, delivered output, source ownership and accepted command state remain unchanged by local reading or motion preference.
Top basis and primary Return remain fully inside their clipping ancestors; keyboard reading does not move the game document.
Normal-motion device preference; finite effects settled without fast-forward and exact pixels unchanged.
